name: codex-quota-monitor
description: Show live Codex limits, cache hit rate, and output speed in a native Windows overlay.

interface.shortDescription: Live Codex limits and token telemetry on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Starts a lightweight Windows overlay with Codex, reads authenticated limits through the official Codex App Server, and shows cache-hit percentage plus output tokens per second across three switchable compact layouts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Codex quota monitor and explain the current limits.
